opening.argument: The speaker's message is a warning against OneCoin, not an invitation to participate. He directly tells viewers, "guys do not invest into one coin it's a bunch of bs," and characterizes its programs as an effort to make money by recruiting people. He also explains that the website sells education packages ranging from 110 euros to 27,500 euros. Although he discusses planned cryptocurrency education materials, he describes them as unfinished and does not ask viewers to pay, enroll, or provide financial information.
